steps.instruction: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil.
Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 cloves of garlic and 1 1/2 cups of bulgur to the oil.
Add the boiling water to the skillet.
Return to a boil and cover the skillet.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed.
steps.spoken: Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until all of the water is absorbed and the bulgur is soft but still chewy.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/2 cup of chopped scallions, 1/2 cup of grated carrots and 1/4 cup of parsley.
Stir in 1/4 cup of tahini and 2 tablespoons of tomato paste.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of mustard and 1 dash of pepper.
With moistened hands, form the mixture into 6 to 8 burgers.
Cook the burgers in a lightly oiled heavy skillet on medium-low heat for 10 minutes.
Flip the burgers once, when the outside is crunchy.
